name: Table
description: Accessible data presentation driven by column definitions, density, loading, and empty state.
usage:
<Table
  caption="Team members"
  columns={[{ key: 'name', header: 'Name', cell: (row) => row.name }]}
  rows={rows}
  getRowKey={(row) => row.id}
/>

anatomy.description: The overflow wrapper with role="region" named after the caption; it takes keyboard focus only when it actually scrolls.
Visually hidden caption announcing the table's subject to screen readers.
Uppercase th cells with scope="col", one per column definition, on a raised surface.
One tr per record keyed by getRowKey; each column's cell renderer produces the td content.
Skeleton rows with a busy region while loading, or the empty content spanning all columns when rows is empty.

dos: Always pass a caption; it names both the region and the table for assistive technology.
Use density="compact" in dashboards and side panels where vertical space is scarce.
Give empty a helpful message that explains why there are no rows.
donts: Don't add sorting or row selection here; use DataTable, which layers both on this contract.
Don't derive row keys from array indexes; getRowKey should return a stable id.
Don't put unlabeled icon buttons in cells; every interactive cell needs an accessible name.

examples.title: Column definitions
examples.description: Columns declare their header and cell renderer; rows need a stable key.

examples.title: Loading state
examples.description: loading swaps in skeleton rows, marks the region busy, and announces the loadingLabel.

guidance.useWhen: Records need readable rows and columns without sorting or selection.
guidance.avoidWhen: Rows need sorting or bulk selection; use DataTable. Hierarchical data fits TreeView better.
guidance.behavior: Columns declare a header and a cell renderer; loading swaps in skeleton rows and marks the region busy; an empty rows array shows the empty content.
guidance.responsive: The region scrolls horizontally when columns overflow and takes keyboard focus only then.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the scroll region when the table overflows horizontally.
Scrolls the region horizontally when the table overflows.

notes: The caption is announced to screen readers and kept visually hidden.
Header cells use scope="col", and the table keeps real table semantics for screen reader navigation.
Skeleton rows are announced through loadingLabel while data loads.
The scroll region is a tab stop only while the table overflows; tables that fit their container are skipped.
